entities.summary: Pau Riba i Romeva (b. 1948-08-07, Palma) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Palma and Spain. Known in the fields of spain, composers & musicians, europe.
